name: liquid-glass-kit
description: Apple Liquid Glass UI materials for React — refractive LiquidGlass component (jh3y's SVG displacement technique) with frosted-glass CSS fallbacks

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js src/motion.jsx --bundle --external:react --external:framer-motion --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.js --banner:js="'use client';" && esbuild src/index.js src/motion.jsx --bundle --external:react --external:framer-motion --format=cjs --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --banner:js="'use client';" && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css && cp src/index.d.ts src/motion.d.ts dist/

author: kv
